design: Exceptionally tall heavily built courier with a flattened broad cranium, short tusked mandibles and thick layered dreadlocks reaching shoulder blades. Twin trapezoid side pouches, a horizontal roll secured high on back, broad harness with circular bronze chest clasp, short protective skirt tabs. Both hands rest on the upper harness straps, broad stable idle stance. Charcoal-grey scales with pale mottling.
